verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Sandboxes is a programmatic SDK driven entirely from Worker code. It is headless by design: `sandbox.exec()` runs commands and captures stdout, stderr and exit codes, and Git operations can be automated. The docs also name CI/CD systems as a target use case. However, there is no documented guide or tooling for running it from a CI pipeline, and no hands-on evidence of CI use, so coverage is only partial. missing for 10: a documented CLI or CI-runner integration (e.g. a pipeline example or GitHub Actions guide), a concrete end-to-end CI automation walkthrough, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
